title: Framework PR #37 Change Record retains stale no-merge delivery instruction
profile: Framework PR #37 explicitly authorized master integration
technical_claim: The original PR #37 Change Record and GitHub PR description retained Draft/no-merge delivery assertions after the delivery scope changed. The paired record and PR-description corrections are now merged and their original stale wording no longer reproduces on resulting Framework master.
entry_point: Versioned Framework Change Record delivery statements and GitHub PR #37 description consumed during master-integration review.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: Historical Draft-PR constraints are presented as current delivery requirements in versioned traceability and PR metadata, which would make an authorized protected PR merge contradict the published delivery record.
observed_behavior: Both English and German Change-Record variants prohibited a master merge at c1523a8f51b2647228dea44284fa8d4a7ac38710; after their source correction, the GitHub PR description also named the old head and Draft/no-merge state. Exact head 1e9fa0d22639517193d450b05eb7b07193e41257 was normally merged as f73f8842f45318e2df8aff1d31855eeb7c20a22f. A scoped resulting-master rerun finds neither original stale no-merge phrase, while both records still prohibit direct master pushes.
expected_behavior: The paired records and GitHub PR description distinguish historical Draft-PR constraints from the current explicit authorization, prohibit direct master pushes, and require any merge to use a fresh verified PR workflow. This behavior is present on resulting master f73f8842f45318e2df8aff1d31855eeb7c20a22f.
impact: The contradictory traceability record was a P1 Framework release blocker because it could have misrepresented delivery constraints to maintainers. Its scoped repair is verified; the independent Framework default-branch Sonar gate is tracked by FND-SONAR-0002 and does not reopen this documentation finding.
preconditions: Framework PR #37 remains the selected user-authorized delivery target.
The PR-head Change Record is part of the versioned diff.
reproduction: Inspect the English and German Change Records at c1523a8f51b2647228dea44284fa8d4a7ac38710.
Compare their no-merge wording with the current user request to integrate Framework PR #37 into master.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped GitHub PR metadata/check review and exact-head Change-Record inspection
evidence.summary: The exact PR head is draft/clean with successful checks, while both paired Change Records still prohibit merging and claim an unmerged PR is required.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped GitHub PR metadata read followed by scoped REST PR-body correction
evidence.summary: The GitHub PR description still called the corrected PR Draft, named old head c1523a8f, denied a master merge, and said checks were running; only its body was corrected.

evidence.command: RTK GitHub PR/master readback; exact-master Change-Record stale-phrase absence and direct-push-control grep; merged-range whitespace check
evidence.summary: PR #37 source 1e9fa0d was merged normally as Framework master f73f884. The original stale no-merge phrases are absent on resulting master, while direct-master-push prohibitions remain. The separate master Sonar failure is recorded under FND-SONAR-0002.

root_cause: The Change Record preserved a now-superseded Draft-PR instruction as if it were a permanent delivery rule and was not reconciled when current user authorization changed the delivery scope.
proposed_remediation: Completed: update only the paired Change Record wording to retain historical context, forbid direct master pushes, and make a protected merge conditional on the current explicit authorization and fresh exact-head validation. Documentation, security, exact-head CI/Sonar, protected merge, and scoped post-merge wording verification were then completed.
acceptance_criteria: English and German Change Records have equivalent, truthful delivery wording.
The GitHub PR description names the current head and accurately states scope, completed checks, and conditional protected delivery.
The records preserve the direct-master-push prohibition and do not self-authorize a merge.
A merge remains conditional on current explicit user authorization and a fresh exact-head validation cycle.
The follow-up PR head, hosted checks, SonarQube Cloud, master result, and boundaries are verified before this finding is closed.
validation_plan: Review the paired record diff and run the Framework documentation and whitespace checks.
Read the GitHub PR description after its scoped correction and compare it with exact PR metadata.
Run selected Framework security and regression checks at the follow-up head.
Verify exact-head GitHub checks/Sonar/reviews, merge through the approved PR flow, and verify resulting master.
legitimate_control_tests: The records continue to forbid a direct master push and require exact-head validation before a merge.
bypass_review: Confirm the revised wording does not weaken branch protections, bypass checks, or treat the record itself as merge authority.
deduplication_note: FND-PARENT-0039 concerns a different Parent PR and Change Record. This is a distinct Framework-owned record, PR, and independently remediable delivery boundary.
evidence_limitations: The record is a documentation/delivery defect, not an exploitable product security vulnerability.
residual_risk: This documentation finding is verified. The independent FND-SONAR-0002 Framework master Quality Gate failure remains a P1 release blocker because its nine MRTS scanner inputs are `needs_review`; it is not a dependency or recurrence of this delivery-record defect.

delivery_evidence.exact_head_checks: passed including PR-head SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate
delivery_evidence.wording_reproduction: original stale phrases absent on resulting master; direct-master-push prohibition remains
delivery_evidence.independent_master_gate: FND-SONAR-0002 remains blocked and does not reopen this verified documentation finding

history.detail: The paired Change Record at exact PR #37 head c1523a8f51b2647228dea44284fa8d4a7ac38710 forbids a merge and says the PR must remain unmerged, conflicting with current explicit Framework-only master authorization.

The GitHub PR #37 description still declared the old c1523a8f head Draft and said it could not merge after the Change-Record correction and exact-head checks. The PR body alone was replaced with current bilingual scope/validation/conditional-delivery wording; no PR source SHA changed.

Exact source head 1e9fa0d22639517193d450b05eb7b07193e41257 merged normally as Framework master f73f8842f45318e2df8aff1d31855eeb7c20a22f. The original stale no-merge phrases no longer occur in either Change Record, while direct-master-push prohibitions remain. Exact-head PR controls passed before merge. The independent master Sonar Quality Gate failure is FND-SONAR-0002 and does not reopen this finding.
